spacing_and_layout.surface_style: Flat solid surfaces with 1px delicate borders (border-[#E6E4DF]). Avoid heavy drop shadows to maintain an earthy, grounded feel.

buttons.primary: bg-[#2D5134] text-white hover:bg-[#213D26] rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-[#2D5134] text-[#2D5134] hover:bg-[#F0EDE5] rounded-md px-4 py-2 font-medium transition-colors

tables.style: Flat table structure, border-b on rows, py-2 px-3 cells for high density readability. Sticky header with bg-[#F8F7F4].

wizard.style: Stepper with horizontal timeline. Active step highlighted with #D9A036 (Muga Yellow). Completed steps in #2D5134 (Mulberry Green).

leaflet_map.style: border border-[#E6E4DF] rounded-md overflow-hidden h-[400px] z-0 (ensure z-index doesn't overlap Shadcn dropdowns/dialogs)

login_hero.description: Handloom weaving in India, representing the sericulture end-product.
login_hero.usage: Use as a large side-panel image on the login screen, with a dark green overlay (bg-[#2D5134]/40) to make white welcome text readable.

dashboard_illustration.description: Indian farmer in lush green fields.
dashboard_illustration.usage: Use selectively in 'Welcome back' hero widgets on the dashboard or empty states.

empty_state_icon.usage: Use as a decorative background or soft empty-state visual with high transparency.

accessibility.contrast_ratio: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 against backgrounds.
accessibility.data_testid_rule: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Light Theme with Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy).
Dashboards should use 'Control Room' dense bento grid (grid-cols-4) with gap-4 or gap-6.
Do NOT use pure white for the app background. Use #F8F7F4. Cards are pure white #FFFFFF.
Avoid Inter and generic fonts. Use Manrope for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body.
Forms and Wizards must be strictly linear and use Shadcn Form, Input, Select, etc. Add generous padding (p-6) inside form cards.
For Leaflet Maps, enforce z-index rules (z-10 or z-0) so Shadcn dropdowns (z-50) appear above the map.
Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, tabs, and links.
